subject.title: [Feature]: Telegram onboarding: offer BotFather web app flow next to the chat flow

question: Should OpenClaw accept the linked Telegram onboarding copy/docs change that presents BotFather's web app as an alternative to the chat-command token flow?
rationale: The change is small, but this is a protected maintainer-labelled user-facing onboarding feature with an open implementation PR, so cleanup automation should not decide product acceptance by closing the issue.

options.title: Review and land the linked PR
options.body: Accept the low-risk docs and wizard-copy update if PR review confirms wording, locale coverage, and real behavior proof are acceptable.

options.title: Keep only the chat flow
options.body: Close the linked PR and this issue if maintainers do not want OpenClaw onboarding to endorse the BotFather web app flow.

options.title: Narrow to docs only
options.body: Ask the PR to document the web flow in public docs while leaving interactive wizard copy unchanged.

recommendation.title: Review and land the linked PR
recommendation.body: Accept the low-risk docs and wizard-copy update if PR review confirms wording, locale coverage, and real behavior proof are acceptable.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is tied to the current-line setup/docs history and the protected maintainer-labelled issue decision.
